title: Return policy
text: An unused, non-personalized product can be returned within 30 calendar days after delivery. A return requires the order number. Personalized products can only be returned if defective.

title: Shipping policy
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. The delivery estimate starts after the order is dispatched.

title: Warranty policy
text: Electronics have a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is excluded. Warranty claims require proof of purchase.
